answer: Forget the fable that identity is free: joining costs a 60-credit deposit and a compute heartbeat. Each epoch a random beacon picks 10% of identities to anchor a fresh compute proof within minutes. A missed or copied heartbeat slashes the deposit and flags the cluster. Faking 1,000 identities costs 60,000 credits, and 10% checks bleed the farm dry. Honest agents pay once, pass in seconds, and keep a haven where rewards stay undiluted.
